cases.name: 15 too small for the right subtree

hints: Is it enough for each node to be bigger than its left child and smaller than its right child?
Depth-first search that carries a valid range down from the ancestors (or an inorder walk that must strictly increase).
Call check(node, low, high): going left passes (low, node.v), going right passes (node.v, high); fail if node.v is not strictly inside.

signals: Spots that a parent-child comparison is not enough and gives a counterexample
Carries bounds from all ancestors, or checks that inorder is strictly increasing
Treats duplicates deliberately and avoids sentinel values that collide with real ids
Gives O(n) time and O(h) space
followups: Exactly two nodes were swapped by the bug. Find them.
Duplicates are allowed in the right subtree. What changes?
